canonical_core.next_action: Publish the single reviewed PR and let the target branch apply the pending archive-owner integration proposal.
proof_expectations: Disjoint owner workflows from one baseline leave the legacy aggregate unchanged and merge in either order.
Same-owner overlap still fails closed through revision/integration guards.

Ordinary lifecycle, startup, summary, report, reconcile, proof, health, install, and upgrade work without writable global state.
Focused merge-order, migration, absence, generated parity, and repository validation pass.
